text: Rwanda uses long **white front** and **yellow back** licence plates.
text_zh: 盧安達使用長型的**白色前車牌**和**黃色後車牌**。

text: All the coverage in Rwanda is made with a Generation 4 camera. In most of the coverage, the Google car is a pickup truck which will be covered entirely by a **big blur**.
text_zh: 盧安達所有的街景覆蓋都是用第四代相機拍攝的。在大多數的覆蓋中，Google 車是一輛皮卡車，其車身會完全被一個**大模糊塊**遮蓋住。

text: Sometimes the Google car is entirely visible: it is a big **white **or **brown pickup truck** with a brakelight. The camera mount is visible.
text_zh: 有時可以看到整台 Google 車：是一輛帶有煞車燈的大型**白色**或**棕色皮卡車**。相機支架清晰可見。

text: The coverage has a noticeable **hazy tint** to it, which is especially apparent in the sky.
NOTE: In Africa, similar hazy Generation 4 coverage is common in Senegal.
text_zh: 街景覆蓋帶有明顯的**朦朧色調**，在天空中尤其明顯。
注意：在非洲，類似的模糊第四代街景在塞內加爾也很常見。

text: Rwandan architecture features a lot of brick and concrete. Most houses in Rwanda are single family houses, which can have rather steep roofs. Houses also often have fences for protection. The most notable feature of Rwandan architecture is the ‘[ventilation bricks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tFoLkC6fLrWChAwQ8),’ which are present in many houses.
text_zh: 盧安達的建築特色包含大量磚造與混凝土結構。盧安達大多數的房屋都是獨棟住宅，屋頂通常較陡。房屋也常有防護用的圍欄。盧安達建築最顯著的特色是「[通風磚](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tFoLkC6fLrWChAwQ8)」，許多房屋都有這種設計。

text: Rwanda is generally quite **hilly**, but not very mountainous.
text_zh: 盧安達整體相當**丘陵起伏**，但不太算高山。

text: Most of the soil in Rwanda has a noticeable red tint to it.
text_zh: 盧安達的大多數土壤都有明顯的紅色調。

text: **Eucalyptus **are very commonly found in Rwanda. They can be identified by their long, often clumped leaves, and smooth bark.
NOTE: Eucalyptus can be found in Kenya and other countries. Use with caution.
text_zh: 盧安達非常常見到**尤加利樹**。其特徵為長而常呈叢狀的葉子以及光滑的樹皮。
注意：肯亞和其他國家也能找到尤加利樹。請謹慎使用。

text: Banana plants are common throughout Rwanda.
text_zh: 香蕉樹在整個盧安達都很常見。

text: Rwanda uses multiple different **red** and **white** **cylindrical** bollards.
text_zh: 盧安達使用多種不同的**紅色**與**白色**的**圓柱形**路樁。

text: Rwanda uses various different styles of white concrete waystones.
text_zh: 盧安達使用各種不同風格的白色混凝土里程碑。

text: Streets in Rwanda are noticeably very **clean** and free of garbage.
text_zh: 盧安達的街道明顯非常**乾淨**且沒有垃圾。

text: Kerbs are often painted with **black and white** stripes.
text_zh: 路緣石經常漆成**黑白**相間的條紋。

text: Villa neighbourhoods often have a lot of tall **security fences and walls**.
text_zh: 別墅區通常有許多高大的**安全圍欄與牆壁**。

text: Rwanda drives on the **right**.
text_zh: 盧安達靠**右**側駕駛。

text: All motorcyclists in Rwanda are required to wear **red vests and helmets**.
text_zh: 盧安達所有機車騎士都必須穿著**紅色背心並戴安全帽**。

text: Rwanda has **quite limited coverage**: street view is limited to Kigali, and a couple of other patches elsewhere in Rwanda.
NOTE: Coverage is being sporadically released, so click the link below to view an up-to-date map.
_You can check out the coverage in detail on [this site](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=10&center=-1.9256780081968785%2C30.20828247070313)._
text_zh: 盧安達的**街景覆蓋相當有限**：街景僅限於基加利（Kigali），以及盧安達其他地區的少數幾個範圍。
注意：覆蓋範圍正陸續零星釋出，因此請點擊下方連結以檢視最新地圖。
_你可以在[這個網站](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=10&center=-1.9256780081968785%2C30.20828247070313)上查看詳細的街景覆蓋。_

text: Street names often have a two-letter code, which tells you the district you are in.
text_zh: 街道名稱通常帶有兩個字母代碼，可告訴你你所在的行政區。

text: Lamps are fairly consistent on National Roads in Rwanda, but other designs can be sometimes found on some sections.
- Roads marked in green mainly use lamps, with lamp arms that have a [slight curve](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oatgzfoVkRCh6UfJ7) near the end and extend past the lamppost.
- Roads marked as red have lamps with [shorter arms](https://maps.app.goo.gl/B9E1RXDR4ZUonFjs6) and a sharper bend near the top of the lamppost.
- Roads marked with blue use lamps with a longer arm that curves for the [entire length](https://maps.app.goo.gl/t21vjYtX5t6ndqHz7).
- Grey roads rarely have lamps.
text_zh: 盧安達國道上的路燈相當一致，但某些路段偶爾也能找到其他設計。
- 以綠色標示的道路主要使用路燈，燈臂靠近尾端處有[微微的彎曲](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oatgzfoVkRCh6UfJ7)並延伸出燈桿外。
- 以紅色標示的道路擁有[較短燈臂](https://maps.app.goo.gl/B9E1RXDR4ZUonFjs6)的路燈，且在燈桿頂部附近有較急的彎折。
- 以藍色標示的道路使用燈臂較長的路燈，該燈臂[整段長度](https://maps.app.goo.gl/t21vjYtX5t6ndqHz7)皆呈現曲線。
- 灰色道路極少有路燈。

text: Lampposts along many national roads will have the road number painted in black letters. Below that, you will find the lamp number, which generally, but not always, increases the further from Kigali you get.
text_zh: 許多國道沿線的燈桿會用黑色字體漆上道路編號。在其下方可以找到燈桿編號，通常（但非絕對）距離基加利越遠，編號就越大。

text: **Tea plantations **are common in Western Rwanda, and a couple other pockets.
text_zh: **茶園**在盧安達西部以及其他少數地區很常見。

text: Northeastern Rwanda has less extreme elevation compared to the rest of Rwanda. It more so consists of rolling hills and open agricultural land or undeveloped grassland.
text_zh: 盧安達東北部的海拔起伏比起盧安達其他地區沒那麼極端。它主要由綿延起伏的丘陵、開闊的農田或未開發的草原組成。

text: **Volcanoes **and **volcanic rocks **can be seen in northwestern Rwanda.
text_zh: 在盧安達西北部可以看到**火山**與**火山岩**。

text: The Akagera national park features a very **vegetated **yet **dry **landscape with wide unpaved roads that are reddish-brown in colour.

You can also find these rectangular [waystones](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.9022489,30.722706,2a,20y,181.31h,78.8t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fw%3D900%26h%3D600%26panoid%3DB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.share%26yaw%3D182.35496720275722%26pitch%3D10.959278061715409%26thumbfov%3D18!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu) at intersections.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.

NOTE: There is some coverage on the [paved section](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.8994956,30.6816537,2a,75y,17.57h,83.7t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D25.209553%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu) south of the national park.
text_zh: 阿卡蓋拉國家公園（Akagera National Park）的地貌非常**植被茂密**卻又**乾燥**，並有著紅褐色的寬闊未鋪裝道路。

你也可以在交叉路口找到這些長方形的[里程碑](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.9022489,30.722706,2a,20y,181.31h,78.8t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fw%3D900%26h%3D600%26panoid%3DB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.share%26yaw%3D182.35496720275722%26pitch%3D10.959278061715409%26thumbfov%3D18!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

注意：國家公園南方的一段[鋪裝路段](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.8994956,30.6816537,2a,75y,17.57h,83.7t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D25.209553%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)也有覆蓋。

text: The Nyungwe Forest National Park goes through a **lush** and **hilly **landscape, which has 2 distinct covered roads; The yellow NR10 is paved, with roadlines. **French style bollards** and** green lamp posts** can be seen on the sides of the road. The[ white NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) going south is mostly paved, except for the [southernmost section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6). No roadlines are present.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.
text_zh: 紐恩威森林國家公園（Nyungwe Forest National Park）穿過一片**蒼翠**且**丘陵起伏**的地貌，這裡有 2 條不同的覆蓋道路：黃色的 NR10 是柏油路，有道路標線。道路兩側可以看到**法式路樁**與**綠色路燈**。往南的[白色 NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) 大部分是柏油路，除了[最南端路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6)外。沒有道路標線。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

text: The NR11 north of Mabanza uses **all white road lines**.
text_zh: 馬班扎（Mabanza）以北的 NR11 使用**全白色道路標線**。

text: The section of NR15 from Muhanga till the Western Province border has very **poor pavement**, with a lot of potholes and a lack of road lines.
text_zh: NR15 從穆漢加（Muhanga）到西部省邊界的這段路面狀況**非常差**，有許多坑洞且缺乏道路標線。

text: The section of NR15 from the Western Province border to [this point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g4dL5u31ULbJrdXw9) is under construction, with no pavement at the moment; making it the only covered National Road to be unpaved for this long. Also, most of the road hugs a steep cliffside made of red dirt.
NOTE: Non-national roads are often unpaved, but they are usually not as wide, and have more stuff going on around them.
text_zh: NR15 從西部省省界到[這個地點](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g4dL5u31ULbJrdXw9)的路段目前正在施工中，暫時沒有鋪裝路面；使其成為唯一一條長期未鋪裝的國道。此外，大部分道路都緊鄰由紅土構成的陡峭懸崖邊。
注意：非國道通常是未鋪裝道路，但它們通常沒那麼寬，且周圍的環境元素比較雜亂。

text: The NR16 is the only road that predominantly uses **dashed **outer white lines.
NOTE: Dashes are also used to indicate intersections elsewhere.
text_zh: NR16 是唯一主要使用**虛線**外側白線的道路。
注意：虛線在其他地方也用於表示交叉路口。

text: A wide river can be seen along the northeastern border of Kigali City.
text_zh: 在基加利市的東北部邊界沿線可以看到一條寬闊的河流。

text: Much of the Kigali coverage is in the richer neighbourhoods. You will see a lot of **luxury villas**.
text_zh: 基加利的大部分街景覆蓋都在較富裕的社區。你會看到許多**豪華別墅**。

text: Many roads in **Butare** feature **cobblestone pavement**.
text_zh: **布塔雷（Butare）**的許多道路都採用**鵝卵石路面**。
